description: This Java class represents a REST API resource for managing Fixed Deposit Accounts within the Apache Fineract platform. It provides endpoints to create, retrieve, update, delete, and perform various operations on fixed deposit accounts, including template retrieval, interest calculation, command execution (approve, reject, close, etc.), and bulk import/export functionalities.

classes.name: FixedDepositAccountsApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource class for fixed deposit account operations, including creation, retrieval, modification, deletion, and specific account actions like approval, interest calculation, and batch processing.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Retrieves a template for creating or maintaining fixed deposit accounts, providing defaults and allowed value lists.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Lists all fixed deposit accounts, supporting pagination and filters.

methods.name: submitApplication
methods.description: Submits a new fixed deposit account application.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific fixed deposit account, optionally including associations.

methods.name: calculateFixedDepositInterest
methods.description: Calculates interest for a fixed deposit based on provided parameters without posting.

methods.name: getActivationCharge
methods.description: Calculates the activation charge for a fixed deposit account.

methods.name: populateTemplateAndAssociations
methods.description: Populates account details along with associated transactions, charges, linked accounts, and templates based on request parameters.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Modifies an existing fixed deposit application in 'submitted' state.

methods.name: handleCommands
methods.description: Performs various state-changing commands on fixed deposit accounts such as approval, rejection, closing, and interest posting.

methods.name: is
methods.description: Utility method to compare command strings ignoring case.

methods.name: accountClosureTemplate
methods.description: Provides a template for closing or performing actions on an account.

methods.name: getFixedDepositTemplate
methods.description: Provides an Excel template for bulk import of fixed deposit accounts.

methods.name: postFixedDepositTemplate
methods.description: Handles uploading an Excel template for bulk import.

methods.name: getFixedDepositTransactionTemplate
methods.description: Provides an Excel template for bulk import of fixed deposit transactions.

methods.name: postFixedDepositTransactionTemplate
methods.description: Handles uploading an Excel template for fixed deposit transactions bulk import.
